verdict.rationale: Morph publishes a first-party coding-agents guide. It covers wiring Claude Code through the natively served Anthropic Messages endpoint at `/v1/messages`, and adding Morph's `edit_file` tool to Codex. A separate MCP guide connects AI tools to Fast Apply and WarpGrep. Community reports confirm real use in goose and in the llm CLI via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Missing for 10: named agent-framework integration guides (e.g., LangChain or similar) beyond generic OpenAI SDK compatibility, and broader coverage of other coding agents beyond Claude Code and Codex.
